visualReview.notes: Inspected all47 current source/shared/medium-fi/native frames in one author/build/inspect/fix pass. Specific irregular main block/two enclosed courtyards/open northern recess, three mapped raised sections, cream two-storey facades/high corner attic tiers, framed windows/pilasters/neutral panel masses and green faceted hip roofs. Portico has ten original faceted Atlas forms with legs, torso/head and raised bent arms supporting the lintel, occupied podium/stairs, sloped side approach, balcony rail and timber doors. Corrected the approach ramp lower endpoint and simplified district bodies/rail repeats before final rendering. Ground statue niches are neutral recessed backs; copied sculpture/anatomy/faces/relief subjects/lettering and furnished collections excluded. Portable backgrounds visible through the courts are intentional: the viewer supplies their native ground. Geometry appearance reviewed; native terrain fit remains rejected.
